blocks.text: The hidden impact of expedited freight costs

Expedited freight costs are rarely just a line item on an invoice. They represent a failure in the upstream planning process. When you rely on rush shipping, you are paying a premium for a lack of foresight. This creates a cycle where you spend more to fix problems that should have been avoided.
Common causes of high transportation spend

items: Fragmented operations: Departments work in silos without shared data.
Legacy systems: Using paper or disconnected spreadsheets leads to errors.
Complexity multiplier: Acquisitions and growth create redundant supplier relationships.
Service-cost trade-off: Chasing perfect service levels without regard for budget.

blocks.text: Practical fixes for logistics cost control

You do not always need expensive software to start controlling costs. Begin by auditing your current freight data in Excel or Google Sheets. Look for patterns in when and why expedited shipping is requested. Often, a single department or supplier is responsible for a disproportionate amount of rush fees.
Use pivot tables to group freight costs by carrier, route, and requester. This often reveals the root cause of excessive spending.

faq.question: How can I reduce expedited freight costs without new software?
faq.answer: Start by auditing your shipping data to identify the top three reasons for rush requests. Once identified, implement a formal approval process for any shipping method that exceeds standard costs.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my ERP system?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any app on your Mac, including web-based ERP interfaces you access via Safari or Chrome. It sees your screen and helps you navigate, but it does not interact directly with the ERP database.

costs.title: Premium Freight Fees
costs.text: Expedited shipping often costs three to five times more than standard ground rates.

costs.title: Administrative Overhead
costs.text: Manual tracking and reconciliation consume hours of your week that could be spent on strategy.

costs.title: Burnout and Turnover
costs.text: The mental cost of constant firefighting leads to high turnover, which costs 50% to 200% of an annual salary.

causes.title: Siloed Data
causes.text: When procurement and logistics do not share data, you lose visibility into true costs.

causes.title: Reactive Planning
causes.text: Relying on last-minute orders forces you to pay for speed rather than optimizing for efficiency.

causes.title: Legacy Processes
causes.text: Using outdated spreadsheets instead of real-time systems leads to data errors and duplication.

fixes.title: Root Cause Audit
fixes.text: Review your last three months of freight invoices. Categorize every expedited charge by reason code.

fixes.title: Standardized Approval
fixes.text: Require a manager sign-off for any shipment that does not meet the standard lead time.

fixes.title: Network Optimization
fixes.text: Use your data to identify which suppliers or routes consistently require rush shipping.
